name: source-plate
summary: A plate that says where something comes from (a person, a paper, a dataset, a quote's source): one look for every plate in a film, up as long as the pace needs to read all of it (never under the floor), no line under the label floor, its lines in window.film.texts for readcheck and textcheck.
use: lay = layout(params, measure) once (measure(text, font) → px); st = state(params, t, lay); canvas(ctx, st, params, lay), or els = build(root, params, lay) once and dom(els, st). texts(params, lay) gives window.film.texts its entries; boxes(params, st, lay) gives window.film.ui(t) its box; readSeconds(text, pace) is how long a text needs.

slots.name: kind
slots.text: person | paper | data | quote | source: what the tag says unless tag is given

slots.name: title
slots.text: the first line: a name, a paper's title, a dataset, the quoted words, copied from the source as it is (hard rule 5)

slots.name: detail
slots.text: the second line: who they are; authors · venue · year; publisher · edition; who said it and where

slots.name: ref
slots.text: an optional third line in the monospaced face: a DOI, an arXiv id, a page, a URL's host and path

slots.name: tag
slots.text: the label over the title; null: by kind and lang; an empty string for none

slots.name: lang
slots.text: the tags' language: zh 人物 论文 数据 原话 出处, en Speaker Paper Data Quote Source

slots.name: t
slots.text: when it starts coming in

slots.name: hold
slots.text: how long it is fully up; null: what the pace needs to read all of it (bin/vh readcheck's count); a hold under the floor (one brisk read, at least 1.5 s) is lengthened to it

slots.name: pace
slots.text: relaxed | normal | brisk: the BRIEF's Pace (playbook/03 §4); brisk is the floor

slots.name: in
slots.text: the move in: the bar grows, the plate opens from its side, the lines come up one after another

slots.name: out
slots.text: the move out: a fade with a short slide toward its side

slots.name: anchor
slots.text: lower-left | lower-right | upper-left | upper-right

slots.name: margin
slots.text: [from the side, from the top or bottom]; null: the title-safe box, 10 % in from each edge

slots.name: width
slots.text: the widest a line runs before it wraps (a long paper title wraps by words, Chinese by characters)

slots.name: size
slots.text: the title's size at 1080p

slots.name: detailSize
slots.text: the detail line's size

slots.name: refSize
slots.text: the reference line's size

slots.name: tagSize
slots.text: the tag's size

slots.name: floor
slots.text: no line drawn under this: the label floor of the BRIEF's Watch on (playbook/03 §4: 44 for desktop and phone, 80 for feed)

slots.name: colors
slots.text: the plate as r,g,b and its opacity, the title, the detail, the reference line, and the accent of the bar and the tag's chip (the tag's letters on it are near-black or white, whichever reads better)

slots.name: font
slots.default: "Helvetica Neue", "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
slots.text: the CSS family list of the tag, title and detail (lib/text.js fontStack(tokens, role) makes one from a style's tokens)

slots.name: weight
slots.text: the title's and the tag's weight

slots.name: detailWeight
slots.text: the detail line's weight

slots.name: mono
slots.text: the reference line's family list

provenance.note: the reading time: the same CJK ranges, paces and floor as bin/vh readcheck (playbook/03 §4)
